items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: You remember those climax records he made for Bill?

ctx.x: No, I didn't know none of the men in his band, because I was just, say, starting out myself. I just probably knew some of the men in the band that I was with that particular day. Yeah. But I didn't know who Howard had with him. But he was playing, say— But I know he had a darn good band.
You remember those climax records he made for Bill?
